english_title: If the Supports Are Compact, Then the Support of the Convolution Is Also Compact
statement_en: If $\operatorname{supp}(f)$ and $\operatorname{supp}(g)$ are both compact, then the support of $f*g$ is also compact.
key_techniques: compactness of sums of compact sets
closed subset of a compact set
